hooks.command: if [ -d myinsights ] && [ -n "$(git status --porcelain myinsights/ 2>/dev/null)" ]; then git add myinsights/ && git commit -m 'docs(insights): auto-capture from session' --quiet 2>/dev/null || true; fi

if [ -f .claude/feature-roadmap.json ] && [ -n "$(git status --porcelain .claude/feature-roadmap.json 2>/dev/null)" ]; then git add .claude/feature-roadmap.json && git commit -m 'docs(roadmap): auto-update from session' --quiet 2>/dev/null || true; fi
if [ -d docs/plans ] && [ -n "$(git status --porcelain docs/plans/ 2>/dev/null)" ]; then git add docs/plans/ && git commit -m 'docs(plans): auto-capture from session' --quiet 2>/dev/null || true; fi
